Subject: Roadmap clarification + open decision log (pre-QBR actions)

Team — following today's cross-functional sync, I captured a short list of open clarifying asks we need to close before the QBR packet is finalized. Please read and reply inline with owners and ETA. I attached a quick spreadsheet for gaps and a starter decision_log.md. High level asks: 

1) Model coverage: confirm which 2.1 variants we are recommending for Hosted vs Dedicated (impact on capacity numbers). Owner: Product
2) Opt-in quantization policy for Dedicated customers—do we present as advisory or opt-out? Owner: Security/Legal input needed
3) Exec ask: point estimate for cost delta if we shift 10% traffic from gpt-redwood-2.1 to rwd-2.1-quantized for high-throughput customers. Owner: Infra/Finance

Quick asks by person:
- Neha: can you confirm the product recommendation matrix by EOD?
- Vivek: need a short blurb on fallback behavior for regional outages (to include in QBR appendix).
- Marissa: please add procurement timing for Acme (they asked for 45-day SLA start).
- Aditya: any exec-level objections to suggesting a temporary promotional credit for enterprise renewals?

Attachments: roadmap_gaps.xlsx (spreadsheet), decision_log.md (text)

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Director, Customer GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Roadmap clarification + open decision log (pre-QBR actions)

Jordan — quick replies inline. I'll update the product matrix tab in the spreadsheet right after this.

1) Model coverage: product recommends rwd-2.1 for Hosted by default; for Dedicated we recommend rwd-2.1-quant (4-bit cast) for customers with throughput > 200 tps. I'll add the thresholds and expected latency deltas to the matrix (ETA: 2026-09-08 17:00 PT).

2) Quantization policy: product prefers an "advisory" posture (document benefits + opt-out process). I'll draft a one-paragraph note for decision_log.md.

3) Cost delta estimate: I don't have precise numbers — need infra/finance input (Aditya + Vivek).

I flagged rows in roadmap_gaps.xlsx where behaviour changes the customer-facing contract.

— Neha

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Roadmap clarification + open decision log (pre-QBR actions)

Thanks — quick notes:

- Fallback behavior: default routing is region-aware; if a region loses all Dedicated capacity we fail over to Hosted in the same geographic region (if available) or to a cross-region hosted pool with priority routing. I'll draft the blurb, but need confirmation from infra on estimated added latency by region (should be <250ms for NA->EU failover in steady-state). Draft blurb attached below (will paste into decision_log.md after review).

- Regarding the 10% traffic move cost delta: infra rough estimate is +12-18% token-cost increase depending on batch size; Aditya++ for finance-model confirmation.

Vivek

Marissa

Circling back on cost numbers — Finance model (quick take): moving 10% traffic to quantized variant shows gross token-cost reduction on compute but increases support/ops per-request overhead (~+3-5%); net impact depends on avg prompt lengths and batch hit rates. I'll attach the summary table in the next 2 hours and drop a short line item for the exec slide (recommended: present midpoint ~+2% net cost with sensitivity band -5% to +7%).

Regarding promotional credit — I'm OK with a limited promo for renewals if PS/CS confirm we can meet delivery dates. Execs want the uplift tied to contract MRR.

— Aditya
